summary: Completed testing of multi-step onboarding questionnaire feature. All 7-step quiz flow, profile saving, match scores, redirect logic, and 'Start Recruiting' navigation work correctly.
passed_tests: POST /api/recruiting-profile saves questionnaire data and sets questionnaire_completed: true
GET /api/match-scores returns scores based on saved profile preferences
Visiting app root (/) redirects to /onboarding when questionnaire NOT completed
7-step quiz flow works correctly (position -> division -> priorities -> regions -> school_size -> academic_interests -> scholarship_priority)
All quiz options are clickable with proper data-testid attributes
Continue/Back buttons work for navigation between steps
Finish button on step 7 saves profile and shows completion screen
Completion screen displays profile summary (position, division, regions, school size, priorities)
Completion screen displays match scores (verified 99%, 99%, 83% for sample programs)
Returning users (questionnaire_completed=true) are NOT redirected to /onboarding
Returning users go directly to /board dashboard
Quiz works in dark theme (verified by screenshots)
critical_code_review_comments: Quiz implementation is well-structured with proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
OnboardingGate component correctly handles redirect logic based on questionnaire_completed flag
Match score calculation works and returns meaningful percentages based on profile preferences
Profile data persistence verified - saved data matches submitted data
seed_data_creation: Used test profile data with various preferences to verify quiz flow
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding questionnaire fully tested. The quiz stores questionnaire_completed flag in athlete_profiles MongoDB collection. First-time users are redirected to /onboarding, returning users go to /board. After completing quiz, users click 'Start Recruiting' to navigate to /pipeline. Match scores are calculated based on profile preferences (division, regions, etc).
